source.citation: Revenue: How do you complete a VAT 3 return?
source.title: Revenue: How do you complete a VAT 3 return?
source.note: Revenue's own page of VAT3 box definitions, quoted passage by passage. It is guidance, not legislation: it explains the return S.I. 639/2010 reg.24 prescribes, and ranks below that Regulation and VATCA s.76. src/domain/vat/boxDefinitions.ts implements the same mapping.

provisions.heading: VAT on sales
provisions.relevanceReason: Curated: a reporting rule cites this passage (vat3RtdCuration.ts).
provisions.excerpt: T1 – VAT on sales This figure is the total VAT due on your: supplies of goods and services intra-Community acquisitions of goods import of goods, where you have applied VAT Postponed Accounting received services , as appropriate.

provisions.heading: VAT on purchases
provisions.relevanceReason: Curated: a reporting rule cites this passage (vat3RtdCuration.ts).
provisions.excerpt: T2 – VAT on purchases This figure is the total VAT which you are entitled to reclaim in respect of costs incurred by you on: goods and services, insofar as they relate to your taxable supplies and qualifying activities. intra-Community acquisitions of goods import of goods where you have applied VAT Postponed Accounting received services flat-rate addition . Where you issue, or receive, a credit note , you may adjust the T1 and T2 figures.

provisions.heading: VAT payable
provisions.relevanceReason: Curated: a reporting rule cites this passage (vat3RtdCuration.ts).
provisions.excerpt: T3 – VAT payable VAT is payable to Revenue where the T1 figure is greater than the T2 figure. The amount payable is the difference between the two figures.

provisions.heading: VAT repayable
provisions.relevanceReason: Curated: a reporting rule cites this passage (vat3RtdCuration.ts).
provisions.excerpt: T4 – VAT repayable VAT is repayable to you where the T2 figure is greater than the T1 figure. The amount repayable is the difference between the two figures. You may have a taxable period w here no VAT is payable, or repayable. I n this instance your VAT 3 must be returned marked zero at T1, T2 T3 and T4. Please note: Do not insert 'nil' on any line.

provisions.heading: intra-European Union (EU) supplies of goods
provisions.relevanceReason: Curated: a reporting rule cites this passage (vat3RtdCuration.ts).
provisions.excerpt: E1 – intra-European Union (EU) supplies of goods This is the total value of goods sent to customers in other EU countries.

provisions.heading: intra-EU acquisitions of goods
provisions.relevanceReason: Curated: a reporting rule cites this passage (vat3RtdCuration.ts).
provisions.excerpt: E2 – intra-EU acquisitions of goods This is the total value of goods received from suppliers in other EU countries.

provisions.heading: intra-EU supply of service
provisions.relevanceReason: Curated: a reporting rule cites this passage (vat3RtdCuration.ts).
provisions.excerpt: ES1 – intra-EU supply of service This is the total value of services supplied to customers in other EU countries.

provisions.heading: intra-EU acquisition of services
provisions.relevanceReason: Curated: a reporting rule cites this passage (vat3RtdCuration.ts).
provisions.excerpt: ES2 – intra-EU acquisition of services This is the total value of services received from suppliers in other EU countries.

provisions.heading: postponed accounting
provisions.relevanceReason: Curated: a reporting rule cites this passage (vat3RtdCuration.ts).
provisions.excerpt: PA1 – postponed accounting This is the total of the Customs value of goods imported under postponed accounting, as per Customs Declarations plus Customs Duty.
